packageRules.description: Hold Gradle at 9.6.x. Gradle 9.7.0 makes ExecSpec.getStandardOutput() return null until it is set, and the Compose Multiplatform plugin (1.11.1) reads it as a non-null Kotlin platform type in ExternalToolRunner, so :desktop:proguardReleaseJars dies with 'getStandardOutput(...) must not be null' and the Linux release build never produces an app-image. Drop this rule once Compose ships the fix (not in 1.11.1; 1.12.0 is still pre-release).
